added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite gate logs; baseline_suite (6583d7b7f) failing ids are tests/test_metadata_index_survives_restart.py::test_the_change_watch_invalidates_the_tree and tests/test_one_sprint_item_slug.py::test_consumers_share_the_one_reader (chunk_07) plus tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py::test_every_staged_write_reaches_the_owner (chunk_12); after_suite (73fab3359) fails the identical three, read from arm_base_suite and arm_head_suite and their per-chunk logs, so the head-minus-base set is empty.

0.reason: the locale pinning is guarded by test_git_is_asked_in_the_c_locale, which the recorded locale control reddens; the non-C case is a behaviour statement that holds wherever a catalogue exists and is harmless where none does

findings.text: follow-on: test_outside_root_is_remembered_under_a_non_c_locale claims to exercise the locale pinning, but on a host with no French catalogue it is equivalent to the plain outside-root case and does not fail when LC_ALL=C is removed from the spawn; negative_control_locale.log reddens only test_git_is_asked_in_the_c_locale at :222, so this case cannot catch the regression its docstring implies.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 78be02692; 73fab3359 deletes _run_git_head, extends _run_git with report_failure and an LC_ALL=C spawn environment at reckon/serve.py:1549, and 9c0403f9e and d7f624486 record the rule in the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when bounds a >=10-plan no-.git audit at one git process, requires the in-repository tree to read base-equal ages, and requires the importing test files to give the same pass and fail ids at head as at base; the gate at head reports 7 passed EXIT=0 (gate_locale_head.log) and the manifest records two 137-file arms that agree chunk for chunk.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a docs root outside any git repository is remembered as such so later age and HEAD lookups spawn no git; reckon/serve.py:1707 _git_head consults the new _git_says_outside_repository at reckon/serve.py:1696 and remembers the root at reckon/serve.py:1739 only for git's own not-a-repo exit.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the 7-passed gate command with its log, the two suite arms with their failure ids and a failure_attribution for each of the three, three red negative controls with their exit codes, and an unrepaired nested-root key mismatch stated rather than absorbed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/serve.py, tests/test_a_tree_outside_git_asks_once.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline/a-tree-outside-git-asks-once.html and docs/figures/...; the three commits since the last review touch only the first three, all inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_tree_outside_git_asks_once.py:251 reddens when LC_ALL=C is removed from the spawn (negative_control_locale.log) and the timeout cases at :176 and :279 redden under the remember-any-failure mutation.
justifications.evidence: gate_locale_head.log names revision 73fab3359 and reports 7 passed EXIT=0, and arm_base_suite and arm_head_suite agree chunk for chunk; the two commits above 73fab3359 are docs-only, so the arm's code is the reviewed head's code.
justifications.fit: the report_failure flag at reckon/serve.py:1533 follows the module's keyword-only optional-argument idiom and _git_says_outside_repository at reckon/serve.py:1696 matches the surrounding small-helper style, though its one-line body is called once.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/serve.py:1727 short-circuits a remembered outside root before the spawn and reckon/serve.py:1739 records the root only when git's own exit names no repository.
justifications.reuse: the duplicated _run_git_head is deleted and its plumbing folds into the module's existing _run_git owner at reckon/serve.py:1528; a search of reckon/ for the not-a-repo text finds only reckon/serve.py:1704, so the classifier had no owner to extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: every file in the diff since 9c0403f9e is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the only reach beyond the HEAD lookup is routing the two other _run_git callers through the same locale-pinned spawn.
